messages.snippet: The document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 18 October until 02:00 Sun
messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance – Saturday 18 October
messages.plaintextBody:
The document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 18 October until 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents before then. No action is otherwise required.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
